name: Three channel CFG
plain: CFG on the first three channels only, leaving the rest as cond. The function name is explicit, and the comment says this is the DiT/SiT form and questions whether it is a bug. The pack also has a rescale variant that blends the multiplier, not the output. OpenDIT also guides three channels but keeps each half's own remaining channels; city96's DiT port guides all in_channels instead.
math:
c3: x[0:3]=u[0:3]+s(c[0:3]−u[0:3]), x[3:]=c[3:].
Rescale: g=u+s(c−u); k=std(c)/(std(g)+1e-6); out=g·(k·r+1−r). Prints the scale each call.

providers.author: city96
providers.note: Same function with the 3 channel line commented out; guides all in_channels
